text:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync — we're doing a 3-day mini sprint to launch a tiny refapp + benchmark blog next week. Goal: blog + demo video + 30-min webinar. :rocket:
Alex (DevRel): Nice. Which model variants are we benchmarking? tiny/medium/quantized?
Tess (Engineering): Plan is small Llama-2 style open weights + a 4-bit quantized variant. I'll run perf today and drop numbers.
Jordan (Product): Webinar target audience = indie devs + platform engineers. Keep it tactical: how to integrate, cost tricks, routing.
Maya (Marketing): Exactly. Need a short launch post (500–700 words), a short demo vid (2–3min), and a one-pager with routing + cost tips. Who owns each?
Sam (Content): I'll draft the blog + slides. Can Tess add a short perf table and CLI snippet?
Tess (Engineering): Yep. I'll add this sample in the repo:
```
# run benchmark
./run_bench --model open-small --quantize 4 --seq 512 --batch 8
# results -> latency/cost CSV
```
I'll paste CSV results in the doc.
Nora (Ops): For inbound leads — we should route webinar signups into the devcontent project in HubSpot and tag as "refapp-mini-sprint". Sam can you add a hidden form field "refapp_source=webinar"?
Sam (Content): Yup — will include. Also suggest gating the downloadable demo assets behind the form for better qualification.
Alex (DevRel): For the demo repo README, add a short snippet showing the Redwood API call and routing example. Something like:
```
POST /v1/generate
{ "model": "open-small-quantized", "prompt": "Summarize..." }
```
and a note on autoscaling / fallbacks.
Maya (Marketing): Timeline check — blog + demo ready by Thu EOD, video by Fri noon, webinar Wed next week. Is that tight? :eyes:
Tess (Engineering): I can get perf numbers and the repo changes by Thu morning.
Jordan (Product): Content review Wed afternoon. I'll do a product pass.
Nora (Ops): I'll set up the HubSpot form + routing rules today. Proposed rules: webinar tag, refapp-mini-sprint list, assign lead to devcontent queue.
calendar-bot: Created calendar event "Refapp mini sprint webinar" — Wed 11:00-11:30. Invitees: @Maya, @Alex, @Sam, @Jordan, @Tess, @Nora :calendar:
Maya (Marketing): Awesome. One more — messaging hooks: please include one clear CTA for engineers ("Try the refapp in under 5 minutes") and one for platform teams ("Contact sales for Dedicated sizing").
Alex (DevRel): I'll write a couple of short code-first CTAs and a step-by-step quickstart for the repo.
Sam (Content): I'll iterate messaging after product pass. Will drop initial draft in #docs-review for comments.
Maya (Marketing): Great. I'll prepare launch post meta (OG image, twitter copy, email blurb). Who can help with a quick OG mock? @Tess?
Tess (Engineering): I can mock something simple by Thu.
Jordan (Product): Let's reconvene tomorrow 10am to check blockers.
Maya (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll keep the task list updated in the shared Notion and ping when drafts land. :+1:
